summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, a parametrized valid/invalid test, and a non-node input test. The 41 tests across the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the prepared venv. No existing files changed and nothing was committed. Two choices to note: an explicit Node isinstance guard runs before graph lookups, because Graph.value(None, ...) acts as a wildcard; and the test module lives in test/test_extras/. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the venv, so formatting and type checks were checked by hand only.
